#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=marl-eval
#SBATCH --output=logs/%j_%x.out
#SBATCH --error=logs/%j_%x.err
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-gpu=8
#SBATCH --mem-per-gpu=64G
#SBATCH --partition=dgxh,preempt
#SBATCH --account=eecs
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --time=1-00:00:00
#SBATCH --constraint=h100|h200
#SBATCH --exclude=dgxh-1
#SBATCH --requeue
# Rendered by "scripts/launch.py eval" from scripts/slurm/eval.sbatch.tmpl.
# The evaluator starts its own LoRA-enabled vLLM server and appends one line per checkpoint
# to its --output-json file, so an interrupted job can be re-submitted.

unset ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES
cd <REPO>
source scripts/env.sh
set -x


export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING=True

python -m marl_workflows.eval.evaluate_checkpoints --task-type math --checkpoints-dir checkpoints/marl-llm-workflows --dataset dapo_math --use-training-lengths
